reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Using the original GPA when a disease-specific GPA exists for the primary.
Mixing points from different GPA versions.
name: Graded Prognostic Assessment (original)

version.label: Original GPA (Sperduto et al. 2008, RTOG database)
version.detail: Four factors scored 0, 0.5 or 1; total 0–4. Superseded for most primaries by disease-specific GPAs (DS-GPA, updated GPAs), which are separate versions and are not combined here.

purpose: Estimates median survival group for patients with brain metastases.
intendedPopulation: Adults with brain metastases (derived from 1,960 RTOG trial patients).

calculatorNotice.title: Original, non-disease-specific GPA
calculatorNotice.message: Disease-specific GPAs are preferred where one exists for the primary tumour. Survival figures are RTOG trial medians from the 2008 derivation.

resultStates.label: GPA 0–1
resultStates.summary: Median survival 2.6 months in the RTOG derivation data.
resultStates.detail: Group-level median from trial patients; integrate with oncology input and current treatment options.

resultStates.label: GPA 1.5–2.5
resultStates.summary: Median survival 3.8 months in the RTOG derivation data.

resultStates.label: GPA 3
resultStates.summary: Median survival 6.9 months in the RTOG derivation data.

resultStates.label: GPA 3.5–4
resultStates.summary: Median survival 11.0 months in the RTOG derivation data.

clinicalContext.text: The first GPA, combining four factors into a prognostic index for brain metastases.

clinicalInsights.text: Survival has improved with modern systemic and targeted therapy; derivation medians may underestimate current survival.

limitations.text: Superseded for most primaries by disease-specific GPAs.

limitations: Derived from patients enrolled in RTOG trials, mainly treated with whole-brain radiotherapy.
Age boundary at 60 is printed differently in some reproductions.

confounders.effect: Affects counts of brain and extracranial metastases.

whatItDoesNotTellYou: Survival for a specific primary tumour type (see disease-specific GPA).

guideSections.what: A 0–4 prognostic index for brain metastases from age, KPS, number of brain metastases and extracranial metastases.
guideSections.whenToUse: Prognostic description where a disease-specific GPA is not available, or for historical comparison.
guideSections.howToPerform: Score each of the four factors 0, 0.5 or 1. Add the four scores.
guideSections.clinicalContext: One input to multidisciplinary decisions with tumour-specific information.

sources.citation: Sperduto PW, Berkey B, Gaspar LE, Mehta M, Curran W. A new prognostic index and comparison to three other indices for patients with brain metastases: an analysis of 1,960 patients in the RTOG database. Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys. 2008;70(2):510-514.
